parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
altitude[æltətju:d]n.
The altitude of a place is its height above sea level.
→ The air was thin at such a high altitude on the mountain.
😎
coastline[koustlain]n.
A coastline is the outline of a country's coast.
→ He noticed that most of the cities in Australia are on the coastline.
😎
deter[ditə:r]v.
To deter means to prevent or discourage someone from doing something.
→ Icy roads deter people from driving their cars.
😎
devise[divaiz]v.
To devise something means to have an idea or plan about it in the mind.
→ The thieves devised a plan to steal the diamonds.
😎
expertise[ekspə:rti:z]n.
Expertise is the knowledge and skills to do something well.
→ John has a lot of advertising expertise. He can sell anything!
😎
fracture[fræktʃər]n.
A fracture is a crack or break in something.
→ Don't stand on that leg because there is a fracture. It might get worse.
😎
impair[impeər]v.
To impair something means to damage it or make it worse.
→ Drinking coffee impairs my ability to go to sleep.
😎
implement[impləmənt]v.
To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.
→ The school decided to implement a new teaching strategy.
😎
indigenous[indidʒənəs]adj.
If something is indigenous, it is originally from, or native to, a place.
→ Tomatoes are indigenous to the Americas.
😎
insight[insait]n.
Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.
→ The physics textbook gave the student new insight about gravity.
😎
limb[lim]n.
A limb is a large branch on a tree.
→ The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.
😎
migraine[maigrein]n.
A migraine is a painful headache that makes one feel sick.
→ My sister gets a migraine every time she has a lot of stress.
😎
optimism[aptəmizəm]n.
Optimism is the feeling of being hopeful about the future or success of something.
→ The mother had optimism about her children's futures.
😎
peculiar[pikju:ljər]adj.
When something is peculiar, it is strange, sometimes in a bad way.
→ That peculiar smell coming from the kitchen reminds me of rotten eggs.
😎
proficient[prəfiʃənt]adj.
When a person is proficient at something, they can do it well.
→ Secretaries are proficient at typing quickly.
😎
quest[kwest]n.
A quest is a long and difficult search for something.
→ The treasure hunter went on a quest to find an ancient gold necklace.
😎
ridge[ridʒ]n.
A ridge is a long, narrow piece of raised land.
→ The brown bear walked along the edge of the mountain ridge.
😎
spouse[spaus]n.
A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.
→ I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.
😎
thrust[θrʌst]v.
To thrust means to push or move something quickly with a lot of force.
→ The boxer thrust his fist into the punching bag.
😎
tolerate[taləreit]v.
To tolerate something means to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant.
→ When you are in a hurry, it can be hard to tolerate traffic signals.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What would be hard to tolerate?
questions.explanation: tolerate nghĩa là chịu đựng; gãy chân (A broken leg) là điều khó chịu đựng.

questions.content: What is something that could be implemented?
questions.explanation: implement nghĩa là thi hành/thực hiện; kế hoạch (A plan) là thứ có thể thực hiện.

questions.content: What has a ridge?
questions.explanation: ridge nghĩa là dải núi/chóp núi; ngọn núi (A mountain) có dải núi.

questions.content: What would be peculiar to find in the ocean?
questions.explanation: peculiar nghĩa là kì lạ; tìm thấy lạc đà (A camel) trên đại dương là kì lạ.

questions.content: What would impair vision?
questions.explanation: impair nghĩa là làm suy giảm/hư hại; ánh sáng chói lọi (A bright light) có thể làm hại thị lực.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: fracture
questions.explanation: fracture nghĩa là chỗ gãy/rạn nứt, đồng nghĩa với a break.

questions.content: limb
questions.explanation: limb nghĩa là cành cây, đồng nghĩa với a branch.

questions.content: thrust
questions.explanation: thrust nghĩa là đẩy mạnh, đồng nghĩa với to push.

questions.content: indigenous
questions.explanation: indigenous nghĩa là bản địa, đồng nghĩa với native.

questions.content: devise
questions.explanation: devise nghĩa là phát minh/nghĩ ra/lên kế hoạch, tương đương với to plan.

questions.content: optimism
questions.explanation: optimism nghĩa là sự lạc quan, đồng nghĩa với một cảm giác tốt (a good feeling).

questions.content: insight
questions.explanation: insight nghĩa là sự hiểu biết sâu sắc, đồng nghĩa với an understanding.

questions.content: altitude
questions.explanation: altitude nghĩa là độ cao, đồng nghĩa với height.

questions.content: migraine
questions.explanation: migraine nghĩa là chứng đau nửa đầu, đồng nghĩa với a headache.

questions.content: quest
questions.explanation: quest nghĩa là cuộc tìm kiếm, nhiệm vụ, đồng nghĩa với a search.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Check if the italicized word is used correctly.

questions.content: The little girl loves her cat. She tolerates it when they are together.
questions.explanation: tolerate nghĩa là chịu đựng; nếu cô bé yêu con mèo thì không dùng từ chịu đựng. Sai ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: Going away to college is scary, but I have optimism that I'll have a good time.
questions.explanation: optimism nghĩa là sự lạc quan; hoàn toàn phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: This migraine is killing me. My head hurts so badly that I can't think straight.
questions.explanation: migraine (đau nửa đầu) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh 'my head hurts so badly'.

questions.content: My bike's tire is flat again. I guess I'll have to impair it.
questions.explanation: impair nghĩa là làm hư hại, ở đây nên dùng từ như 'repair' (sửa chữa).

questions.content: Her child is peculiar. He likes to wear his shoes on the wrong feet.
questions.explanation: peculiar nghĩa là kì lạ; việc mang giày ngược chân là một điều kì lạ.

questions.content: The tree is getting too big for our yard! Ask Jim to cut off some of the limbs.
questions.explanation: limb nghĩa là nhánh cây; hoàn toàn hợp lý.

questions.content: I fell off my bike, but I didn't break any bones. I just got a slight fracture on my toe.
questions.explanation: fracture chính là gãy xương/rạn xương, mâu thuẫn với câu trước 'didn't break any bones'.

questions.content: This bush in my yard comes from another country. It's indigenous to my yard.
questions.explanation: indigenous nghĩa là bản địa, nhưng câu trước nói 'comes from another country', như vậy không thể là bản địa.

questions.content: From the mountain ridge, you can see the entire city below.
questions.explanation: ridge là dải núi; đứng từ đó có thể nhìn thấy thành phố bên dưới, hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: Mike is a very proficient reader. He finished the entire novel in just an hour.
questions.explanation: proficient (thành thạo) phù hợp với việc đọc xong một cuốn tiểu thuyết trong một giờ.

questions.content: We were in awe of the professor's expertise on the subject.
questions.explanation: expertise là chuyên môn; hợp lý khi nói về một giáo sư.

questions.content: You should thrust the baby when putting him in bed, so he doesn't wake up.
questions.explanation: thrust là đẩy mạnh; không ai đẩy mạnh một em bé khi đặt xuống giường.

questions.content: I will get married to my spouse one year from today.
questions.explanation: spouse là người bạn đời (vợ/chồng đã kết hôn), bạn không thể nói 'sẽ kết hôn với người vợ/chồng hiện tại'.

questions.content: Australia has a very long coastline.
questions.explanation: coastline (đường bờ biển), hợp lý vì Úc là một đảo quốc rộng lớn.

questions.content: She is on a quest to find her long lost brother.
questions.explanation: quest là cuộc tìm kiếm; hoàn toàn hợp nghĩa.

questions.content: If you don't like your job, you should devise it.
questions.explanation: devise là nghĩ ra/lên kế hoạch; không hợp lý trong ngữ cảnh không thích công việc.

questions.content: She will have to get more altitude if she wants to swim faster.
questions.explanation: altitude là độ cao, bơi lội thì không cần độ cao.

questions.content: The workers implemented a new strategy to be more efficient.
questions.explanation: implement (thi hành/áp dụng) chiến lược mới là hoàn toàn đúng.

questions.content: Nothing will deter me in my hunt for the perfect flower.
questions.explanation: deter (cản trở); hợp lý, ý nói không gì cản trở được.

questions.content: Her insight into our problem really helped us out.
questions.explanation: insight (sự thấu hiểu) giúp giải quyết vấn đề, rất hợp nghĩa.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Island

"Where am I?" Bob thought to himself when he woke up on a peculiar beach. "I can't remember what happened." There had been a bad storm, and Bob's fishing boat sunk. He washed ashore on a small island, but he had gotten hurt during the storm. He had a terrible migraine, and he had a fracture in his shoulder. He felt awful. But he had a strong desire to make it home to his spouse and children. He had to tolerate all the pain and devise a plan.

Bob stood up and looked around. "I'll walk to a higher altitude, so I can see everything around me," thought Bob. "Maybe I'll gain some insight about this island and find something to help me escape." As he walked along a mountain ridge, he noticed that the tall indigenous trees looked sturdy and thick. Bob got a brilliant idea. He could build a raft! He cut down some leaves and tree limbs. Even though his shoulder injury impaired his ability to carry the materials, he slowly dragged them down the mountain until he reached the coastline.

Bob was a proficient builder. He used his building expertise to line up the limbs and tie them together with long vines. When the raft was finished, Bob was happy with his work. "This will bring me home to my family," he said with a smile.

At last, Bob was ready to implement his escape plan. With all his might, he thrust the raft into the water. He climbed on and began the quest to find his way home. Bob smiled again, and thought, "I'm glad I kept a good attitude. It prevented the pain from deterring me from my plan. Optimism and ambition make anything possible."

Slowly, he floated out to sea. In a few days, he made it to shore and ran home to see his happy family.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: Bob had a migraine and a shoulder fracture when he awoke on the peculiar beach.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Bài đọc có câu: "He had a terrible migraine, and he had a fracture in his shoulder."

questions.content: Bob implemented a plan to bring his spouse and children to the island.
questions.explanation: Sai. Bob thực hiện kế hoạch để "return home to his spouse and children" (trở về nhà với vợ và các con), chứ không phải mang họ đến hòn đảo.

questions.content: The indigenous tree limbs impaired Bob's ability to carry the materials.
questions.explanation: Sai. Bài đọc viết "his shoulder injury impaired his ability to carry the materials" (chấn thương vai của anh ấy làm suy yếu khả năng mang vác vật liệu), không phải do cành cây.

questions.content: Bob was proficient in building, and he used his expertise to build the raft.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Bài đọc có câu: "Bob was a proficient builder. He used his building expertise to line up the limbs..."

questions.content: Bob thrust the raft into the water to begin his quest.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Bài đọc viết: "he thrust the raft into the water. He climbed on and began the quest to find his way home."

sections.title: Part B: Answer the questions.
sections.content: Part B: Choose the correct answer for each question.

questions.content: What type of insight did Bob hope to gain when he moved to a higher altitude?
options: Insight about the island and finding something to help him escape.
Insight into building a new house on the beach.
Insight into how the storm started.
Insight about the indigenous animals on the island.
questions.explanation: Bob hy vọng có cái nhìn sâu sắc (insight) về hòn đảo và tìm thấy thứ gì đó giúp anh ta trốn thoát.

questions.content: Why did Bob need to tolerate the pain and devise a plan?
options: Because he wanted to explore the entire island.
Because he wanted to make it home.
Because he needed to find food and water.
Because he wanted to build a permanent shelter.
questions.explanation: Bob phải chịu đựng cơn đau và vạch ra kế hoạch vì anh có khao khát mãnh liệt được trở về nhà với gia đình.

questions.content: What did Bob drag from the ridge to the coastline?
options: He dragged his broken fishing boat.
He dragged a large supply of fish.
He dragged tree limbs and vines.
He dragged heavy stones to build a fire.
questions.explanation: Bob đã chặt cành cây và kéo chúng từ sườn núi xuống bờ biển để làm bè.

questions.content: How did Bob prevent pain from deterring him?
options: By taking some medicine he found.
questions.explanation: Bob nghĩ: "I'm glad I kept a good attitude. It prevented the pain from deterring me from my plan."

questions.content: What does Bob believe about optimism and ambition?
options: They are only useful when building a raft.
They are not as important as survival skills.
questions.explanation: Cuối bài, Bob nghĩ: "Optimism and ambition make anything possible." (Sự lạc quan và hoài bão làm cho mọi thứ trở nên khả thi.)
